section.description: The heading the point goes under, copied exactly from the plan's text, without its #s. A heading the text does not hold opens a new section at its end.

text.description: The new point, added at the end of the section: Markdown, a bullet where the section is a list.

find.description: Text copied exactly from the plan's saved text, as much as names one place: a phrase, lines, or whole sections, headings and their #s included.

text.description: What that text becomes, which may open headings of its own; empty to delete it, and a line the deletion leaves empty is taken out.

notes.description: The notes the latest lines call for, in order, taken together or not at all; empty when nothing new was said.
